id: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Shalom Aleichem
title: Shalom Aleichem

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Shalom Aleichem 1
segments.en:
Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Yehudah said: “Two angels accompany a man on the eve of Shabbos from the synagogue to his home, one good angel and one evil angel.” When the person arrives home to find the lights burning, the table set, and the bed made, the good angel exclaims, “May it be God's will that it be so next Shabbos.” But if not so, if the the house is dark and in disorder, the evil angel exclaims, “May it be God's will that it be so next Shabbos.” The good angel is compelled to answer Amein.—Maseches Shabbos 119b
The custom of singing Sholom Aleichem, peace upon you, upon returning from the synagogue is based on the above Talmudic teaching. Since every Jew is accompanied home by these two angels, it is fitting that he welcome them into his home. Obviously, one should prepare for Shabbos in such manner to evoke the angels' best wishes.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Shalom Aleichem 2
segments.he: שָׁלוֹם עֲלֵיכֶם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁרֵת מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּ֒לָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: <small>ג"פ</small>
segments.en: Peace upon you, angels of God's service, angels of the Most High, from the King of kings-of-kings, the Holy One, blessed is He.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Shalom Aleichem 3
segments.he: בּוֹאֲכֶם לְשָׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּ֒לָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: <small>ג"פ</small>
segments.en: Come in peace, angels of peace, angels of the Most High, from the King of kings-of-kings the Holy One, blessed is He.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Shalom Aleichem 4
segments.he: בָּרְכוּנִי לְשָׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּ֒לָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: <small>ג"פ</small>
segments.en: Bless me with peace, angels of peace, angels of the Most High from the King of kings-of-kings the Holy One, blessed is He.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Shalom Aleichem 5
segments.he: צֵאתְכֶם לְשָׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּ֒לָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: <small>ג"פ</small>
segments.en: Go in peace, angels of peace, angels of the Most High from the King of kings-of-kings the Holy One, blessed is He.

segments.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Shalom Aleichem 6
segments.he: כִּי מַלְאָכָיו יְצַוֶּה־לָּךְ לִשְׁמָרְךָ בְּכָל־דְּרָכֶֽיךָ: יְהֹוָה יִשְׁמָר־צֵאתְ֒ךָ וּבוֹאֶךָ. מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם:
segments.en: For His angels He will command in your behalf, to guard you in all your ways. Adonoy will guard your going and coming from now, forever.
